40022611.author: पदार्थः
40022611.content: ऋषेः of the sage, वचनम् word, आज्ञाय having understood, रामः Rama, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, उपासितुम् to perform, उपाक्रमत् approached, सरः lake, पुण्यम् sacred, अप्सरोगणसेवितम् frequented by groups of Apsaras

40022611.author: Translation
40022611.content: Having understood the sage's words, Rama approached a sacred lake, frequented by groups of Apsaras, to perform his twilight prayers.

40022612.author: पदार्थः
40022612.content: तत्र there, उदकम् water, उपस्पृश्य having performed ablutions, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, अन्वास्य having performed, पश्चिमाम् western (evening), आश्रमम् hermitage, प्राविशत् entered, रामः Rama, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, महात्मनः of the great-souled one

40022612.author: Translation
40022612.content: There, having performed ablutions and completed the evening twilight prayers, Rama entered the hermitage of the great-souled Agastya.

40022613.author: पदार्थः
40022613.content: तस्य for him, अगस्त्यः Agastya, बहुगुणम् of many qualities, कन्दमूलम् roots and fruits, तथा and, औषधिम् herbs, शाल्यादीनि rice and other grains, पवित्राणि pure, भोजनार्थम् for a meal, अकल्पयत् arranged

40022613.author: Translation
40022613.content: For Rama, Agastya arranged a meal consisting of excellent roots, fruits, herbs, and pure rice and other grains.

40022614.author: पदार्थः
40022614.content: सः he, भुक्तवान् ate, नरश्रेष्ठः best among men, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, प्रीतः pleased, च and, परितुष्टः fully satisfied, च and, ताम् that, रात्रिम् night, समुपाविशत् rested

40022614.author: Translation
40022614.content: The best among men, Rama, ate that nectar-like food, and being pleased and fully satisfied, he rested for that night.

40022615.author: पदार्थः
40022615.content: प्रभाते in the morning, काल्यम् early morning duties, उत्थाय having risen, कृत्वा having performed, आह्निकम् daily rituals, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, ऋषिम् to the sage, समुपचक्राम approached, गमनाय for departure, रघूत्तमः best of the Raghu dynasty

40022615.author: Translation
40022615.content: In the morning, having risen and performed his daily rituals, Rama, the subduer of enemies and best of the Raghu dynasty, approached the sage for his departure.

40022616.author: पदार्थः
40022616.content: अभिवाद्य having saluted, अब्रवीत् spoke, रामः Rama, महर्षिम् to the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवम् Agastya (born from a pot), आपृच्छे I ask leave, स्वां my own, पुरीं city, गन्तुम् to go, माम् me, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.

40022616.author: Translation
40022616.content: Having saluted the great sage Agastya, Rama spoke, saying, "I ask your leave to go to my own city, and you ought to permit me."

40022617.author: पदार्थः
40022617.content: धन्यः blessed, अस्मि I am, अनुगृहीतः favored, अस्मि I am, दर्शनेन by the sight, महात्मनः of the great soul, द्रष्टुं to see, च and, एव indeed, आगमिष्यामि I shall come, पावनार्थम् for the purification, इह here, आत्मनः of my self.

40022617.author: Translation
40022617.content: I am blessed and favored by the sight of your great self, and I shall indeed come here again to see you for the purification of my own soul.

40022618.author: पदार्थः
40022618.content: तथा thus, वदति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे by Rama, वाक्यम् words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful meaning, उवाच spoke, परमप्रीतः extremely pleased, धर्मनेत्रः whose eye is dharma, तपोधनः whose wealth is austerity.

40022618.author: Translation
40022618.content: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.

40022619.author: पदार्थः
40022619.content: अत्यद्भुतम् very wonderful, इदं this, वाक्यं speech, तव your, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् of auspicious words, पावनः purifier, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, त्वम् you, एव indeed, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022619.author: Translation
40022619.content: O Rama, your words are indeed very wonderful and auspicious, for you alone, O delight of the Raghus, are the purifier of all beings.

40022620.author: पदार्थः
40022620.content: मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अपि even, राम O Rama, त्वाम् you, ये those who, च and, पश्यन्ति see, केचन some, पाविताः purified, स्वर्गभूताः become heavenly, च and, पूज्याः worshipable, ते they, सर्वदैवतैः by all deities.

40022620.author: Translation
40022620.content: O Rama, even those who merely see you for a moment become purified and attain heaven, and they are then worshipable by all deities.

40022621.author: पदार्थः
40022621.content: ये those who, च and, त्वां you, घोरचक्षुर्भिः with terrible eyes, पश्यन्ति see, प्राणिनो living beings, भुवि on earth, हतास्ते they are struck down, यमदण्डेन by Yama's rod, सद्यो immediately, निरयगामिनः going to hell

40022621.author: Translation
40022621.content: Those living beings on earth who look at you with hostile eyes are immediately struck down by the rod of Yama and go to hell.

40022622.author: पदार्थः
40022622.content: ईदृशस्त्वं such are you, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, पावनः purifier, सर्वदेहिनाम् of all embodied beings, भुवि on earth, त्वां you, कथयन्तो speaking about, अपि even, सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति will attain perfection, राघव O scion of Raghu

40022622.author: Translation
40022622.content: O best of Raghus, you are such a purifier of all embodied beings, and even those on earth who merely speak of you, O scion of Raghu, will attain perfection.

40022623.author: पदार्थः
40022623.content: गच्छ go, च and, अरिष्टम् auspicious, अव्याग्रः undisturbed, पन्थानम् path, अकुतोभयम् fearless, प्रशाधि rule, राज्यं kingdom, धर्मेण with righteousness, गतिर्हि indeed the support, जगतो of the world, भवान् you

40022623.author: Translation
40022623.content: Go forth calmly on an auspicious and fearless path, and rule your kingdom with righteousness, for you are indeed the support of the world.

40022624.author: पदार्थः
40022624.content: एवमुक्तस्तु thus spoken, मुनिना by the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रग्रहो humble, नृपः the king, अभ्यवादयत saluted, प्राज्ञः the wise (king), तम् that, ऋषिं sage, पुण्यशालिनम् endowed with merit

40022624.author: Translation
40022624.content: Thus addressed by the sage, the wise and humble king, with folded hands, saluted that virtuous sage.

40022625.author: पदार्थः
40022625.content: अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनिश्रेष्ठं the best of sages, तांश्च and them, सर्वान् all, तपोधनान् ascetics, अध्यारोहत् ascended, तदव्यग्रः then undisturbed, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold

40022625.author: Translation
40022625.content: Having saluted the best of sages and all those ascetics, he then calmly ascended the Pushpaka chariot, which was adorned with gold.

40022626.author: पदार्थः
40022626.content: तं him, प्रयान्तं departing, मुनिगणाः groups of sages, हि indeed, आशीर्वादैः with blessings, समन्ततः from all sides, अपूजयन् worshipped, महेन्द्राभं resembling Mahendra, सहस्राक्षम् one with a thousand eyes, इव like, अमराः gods.

40022626.author: Translation
40022626.content: As Rama departed, groups of sages honored him from all sides with blessings, just as the gods worship Indra, who resembles Mahendra and has a thousand eyes.

40022627.author: पदार्थः
40022627.content: स्वस्थः at ease, सः he, ददृशे was seen, रामः Rama, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शशी the moon, मेघसमीपस्थो situated near a cloud, यथा just as, जलधरागमे at the arrival of rain clouds.

40022627.author: Translation
40022627.content: Rama, at ease in the gold-adorned Pushpaka, appeared like the moon near a cloud at the onset of the monsoon season.

40022628.author: पदार्थः
40022628.content: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, पूज्यमानः being honored, ततस्ततः from all sides, अयोध्यां to Ayodhya, प्राप्य having reached, काकुत्स्थो Rama, मध्यकक्ष्याम् the middle chamber, अवारुहत् descended.

40022628.author: Translation
40022628.content: Then, by midday, Rama, being honored from all sides, reached Ayodhya and descended into the middle chamber of his palace.

40022629.author: पदार्थः
40022629.content: ततः then, विसृज्य having dismissed, रुचिरं beautiful, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, कामगामि moving at will, तत् that, विसर्जयित्वा having dismissed, गच्छ go, इति thus, स्वस्ति welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, च and, प्रभुः the lord.

40022629.author: Translation
40022629.content: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."

40022630.author: पदार्थः
40022630.content: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं placed in an inner chamber, द्वास्स्थं to the doorkeeper, रामो Rama, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, भरतं Bharata, च and, एव indeed, गत्वा having gone, तौ those two, लघुविक्रमौ swift-footed, मम my, आगमनम् arrival, आख्याय having announced, शब्दापयत summon, मा not, चिरम् long.

40022630.author: Translation
40022630.content: Rama then spoke to the doorkeeper, who was stationed in an inner chamber, instructing him to swiftly go and inform Lakshmana and Bharata of his arrival, and to summon them without delay. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे व्द्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 82 ।। Thus ends the eighty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
